Application Data.NAME: Sunnydale Dairy Co.
Application Data.DESCRIPTION OF OPERATIONS: Sunnydale Dairy Co. operates a retail dairy and ice cream shop offering a variety of ice cream flavors, milk products, and dairy-based desserts. The business also provides limited food service, including pre-packaged snacks. Our operations include a small area for ice cream manufacturing on-site, ensuring quality control and freshness. We prioritize safety and maintain a strict hygiene protocol in compliance with health regulations and standards. Additionally, we plan to expand our online sales to serve customers in our local community better.

Application Data.DESCRIPTION OF LOSSES: Loss Date: 05/15/2023; Cause: Equipment malfunction during ice cream production; Amount: $2,500.00; Status: Closed.
Application Data.SAFE/VAULT DETAILS: Class B, Grade II, UL Listed
Application Data.OTHER PROTECTION: Central alarm system with 24/7 monitoring; perimeter fencing; on-site security personnel during operating hours.
